prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: standalone BODY illustration for a Jinan cultural feature titled 趵突泉与泉水生活 (Baotu Spring and everyday life around the springs). This is art to accompany prose, not a webpage screenshot or replacement city hero image.

Primary request: ONE original, airy Chinese ink-and-watercolour interpretation of softly upwelling spring water, spreading ripples and a quiet suggestion of a waterside pause. Explicitly an AI creative illustration, not an on-site record, an accurate view of Baotu Spring or Black Tiger Spring, a historical reconstruction, map, real architecture, or current water-level evidence.

Scene and focal subject: A near view of clear water rising in a small rounded cluster, low and gentle rather than a tall jet. Bright untouched paper describes the heart of the upwelling; delicate grey-blue ink and a few fine ripples expand into a broad, calm water surface. At a quiet margin, a minimal unnamed stone-bank edge and sparse, soft lotus-leaf shadows suggest human proximity to the water without showing people or implying a specific place or water-collecting activity. The image is about looking at spring water, not drawing an actual pool plan. No drinking vessels, taps, buckets, explanatory arrows or diagrammatic water flow.

Style and colour: luminous diluted Chinese ink with transparent watercolour, subtle paper absorption, feathered edges, almost-white water highlights, very pale celadon and pearl-grey touches. Give the water exceptional breathing room and visual stillness. Refined contemporary editorial art, not a reproduction of an old painting or a named artist's work. Keep the main spring-water cluster crisp enough to read within the loose washes. Avoid foamy ocean waves, a geyser, waterfalls or dramatic surf.

Composition: ONE complete native landscape 3:2 artwork, ideally 1536 by 1024 pixels. Keep the essential rounded upwelling and several complete ripple rings within the central 42 percent of width and central 60 percent of height, comfortably away from all edges. Side margins can dissolve into quiet paper and a few faint leaves. The water motif should remain intelligible in a centred mobile 4:5 crop, while the original is a balanced full artwork. No illustrated safe-area guides, border, frame or multiple panels.

Authenticity constraints: Any bank, leaf, ripple and water shape is imagined and unnamed, not an exact landform or surveyed water feature. Do not show recognisable real buildings, pavilions, signs, monuments, identifiable faces or portraits. Do not suggest that an imagined everyday scene depicts actual spring-water collection or drinking. No antiquities, archaeological labels, museum object identity, historic stone inscription or contemporary monitoring data.

Text: NONE. No Chinese characters, Latin letters, calligraphy, signatures, seals, logos, watermarks, captions, labels, numerals or pseudo-writing.
Avoid: UI, browser, phones, typography, postcard montage, multiple options, stage light, shadow puppets, woven reed ribbons, baskets, dense textures and theatrical dark stone. One uninterrupted original artwork only.
timePrecision: 原记录起止时间及偏移原样保留
